en: We were going to launch the product in May.
de: Wir wollten das Produkt im Mai auf den Markt bringen.
single: We were going to bildet den Anfang; launch the product in May folgt danach.
why: Were going to nennt den Plan von damals. Danach folgt die Grundform launch.
Were going to names the plan from back then. The base form launch follows.
bad: We are going to launch the product in May.

why.de: Ein Plan von damals braucht were, nicht are.
why.en: A plan from back then needs were, not are.

en: I was going to call you earlier this morning.
de: Ich wollte dich heute früh anrufen.
single: I was going to bildet den Anfang; call you earlier this morning folgt danach.
why: Was going to nennt den Plan. Danach folgt die Grundform call.
Was going to names the plan. The base form call follows.
bad: I was going call you earlier this morning.

en: We were about to sign when the lawyer found an error.
de: Wir wollten gerade unterschreiben, als der Anwalt einen Fehler fand.
single: We were about to bildet den Anfang; sign when the lawyer found an error folgt danach.
why: Were about to heißt: kurz davor. Der Satz mit when zeigt, was dazwischen kam; das ist die Pointe.
Were about to means: just before. The when-clause shows what intervened.
bad: We were about signing when the lawyer found an error.

why.de: Nach about steht to und die Grundform.
why.en: After about comes to and the base form.

en: The meeting was about to start when the power failed.
de: Die Besprechung sollte gerade beginnen, als der Strom ausfiel.
single: The meeting was bildet den Anfang; about to start when the power failed folgt danach.
why: Was about to heißt: kurz davor. Der Satz mit when zeigt, was dazwischen kam; das ist die Pointe.
Was about to means: just before. When shows what intervened.
bad: The meeting was about starting when the power failed.

why.de: Nach about to steht die Grundform.
why.en: After about to comes the base form.

en: She joined the firm in 2015 and would later lead the Berlin office.
de: Sie kam 2015 zur Firma und leitete später das Berliner Büro.
single: She joined the firm in 2015 bildet den Anfang; and would later lead the Berlin office folgt danach.
why: Would later blickt aus der Vergangenheit auf Späteres. Danach folgt die Grundform lead.
Would later looks from the past at something later. The base form lead follows.
bad: She joined the firm in 2015 and will later lead the Berlin office.

why.de: Aus der Vergangenheit heraus steht would, nicht will.
why.en: Seen from the past, would is used, not will.

en: He promised that he would send the report by Monday.
de: Er versprach, den Bericht bis Montag zu schicken.
single: He promised that he bildet den Anfang; would send the report by Monday folgt danach.
why: Nach promised steht would statt will. Danach folgt die Grundform send.
After promised, would replaces will. The base form send follows.
bad: He promised that he will send the report by Monday.

why.de: Nach einem Verb der Vergangenheit steht would.
why.en: After a verb in the past, would is used.

en: The new office was to open in June.
de: Das neue Büro sollte im Juni eröffnen.
single: The new office was to bildet den Anfang; open in June folgt danach.
why: Was to nennt, was vorgesehen war. Danach folgt die Grundform open.
Was to names what was meant to be. The base form open follows.
bad: The new office should open in June.

why.de: Für einen Plan in der Vergangenheit steht was to.
why.en: For a plan in the past was to is used.

en: She was to become the youngest director in the firm.

single: She was to bildet den Anfang; become the youngest director in the firm folgt danach.
why: Was to nennt, was vorgesehen schien. Danach folgt die Grundform become.
Was to names what seemed meant to be. The base form become follows.
bad: She was to became the youngest director in the firm.

why.de: Nach was to steht die Grundform.
why.en: After was to comes the base form.
